programme.desc: S01 E05 — Gambled to Death (The Ernie & Charlene Scherer story) With all the secrets, lies, greed, and infidelity, Ernie and Charlene Scherer's American-dream life was not exactly what it seemed like; a look into how the exposure of their dangerous double life led to one last fatal gamble.
programme.title: A Secret to Die For

programme.desc: S01 E07 — New Orleans The team investigates paranormal activity linked to an overwhelming number of natural disasters, contacts spirits in a hotel built atop a hospital, explores an eerie B & B, and finds troubled souls in America's most haunted city.
programme.title: Destination Haunted

programme.desc: S01 E06 — Tomb Raiders Open burial sites filled with secrets. Find powerful artifacts in a French rulers tomb, see what a tomb adorned with conch shells says about sacred ceremonies, and expose complex beliefs about animals and the afterlife in an Egyptian zoo graveyard.
programme.title: Buried Evidence

programme.desc: S01 E06 — Above the Law Question whether Napoleon Bonaparte was poisoned in exile, then find out whose bones were buried underneath Benjamin Franklin's London home; analyze evidence that suggests that Grand Duchess Anastasia may have escaped the 1918 Romanov massacre.
programme.title: History Unsolved: The Investigation Files

programme.desc: S03 E10 — Animal Oddities Witness animal spectacles from high above the Earth; watch a whirling herd of northern nomads; see undersea behemoths show off in the Pacific shallows; track a U.S. porcine stampede; confront top ocean predators on the Florida coast.
programme.title: Mysteries From Above

programme.desc: Past Lives Exploring beliefs about where people go when they die, reincarnation and unlocking past life memories.
programme.title: World's Most Unexplained

programme.desc: Spontaneous Human Combustion Discussing how the human body can catch fire without cause.
programme.title: World's Most Unexplained

programme.desc: S01 E09 — Multiple Witnesses The existence of an entity is proven when multiple people see the same spirit.
programme.title: Paranormal Survivor

programme.desc: S02 E24 — UFO Window Seat and Lost Underwater City Sighting of a UFO from the window seat of a passenger jet; a strange underwater discovery is said to be a lost Japanese city; a series of tunnels in Brazil; Tony and team investigate some of the world's strangest photos and videos.
programme.title: The Proof Is Out There

programme.desc: S02 E25 — Bigfoot's Death Cry and Bird on Mars Experts investigate the claims of "Ohmawing": the theory that Bigfoot makes sounds that can make people sick; examining images captured by NASA's Perseverance rover on Mars; a figure captured on video may be a fabled Latin American witch.
programme.title: The Proof Is Out There

programme.desc: S02 E10 — Jinn on the Prowl and More A ghost hunter is pushed to the brink by a demonic jinn; a shadow person invades a home in the UK; a creepy doll haunts a suburban basement.
programme.title: Paranormal Caught on Camera

programme.desc: Here begins as a hunt for a paranormal research facility in America's most haunted state turns into a journey filled with discoveries for a team of supernatural investigators.
programme.title: Haunted Discoveries

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Dinosaur Island Human remains are unearthed on Daksa island; flying objects are spotted above Maury Island; on Isle of Wight, remains of a previously unknown species of dinosaur are found; strange ritual artifacts are uncovered on Sweden's Blå Jungfrun Island.
programme.title: Mysterious Islands

programme.desc: S04 E09 — Billy Chemirmir A modus operandi that mimics natural death works to the advantage of a Texas serial killer who preys on elderly victims; his murderous death toll is suspected of having amounted to 22 before a sinister clue leads to his capture.
programme.title: Murder by Medic

programme.desc: S13 E02 — The Telltale Creek People in charming Hope Mills, are on edge when a high school freshman vanishes while on her way to meet a friend. When she turns up dead three weeks later, the community rallies to flush out the killer.
programme.title: City Confidential
